title: Embrace – Embrace health care
text: Scroll to top How can we help? Ask me anything about our services… Mental health support The Capacity Building Category in your NDIS plan aims to boost your independence, skillset, and community involvement, tailoring activities to your needs and goals. It includes the Improved Relationships supports, offering strategies and interventions to enhance communication and behaviour, fostering a better social life and support network. Our mental health support plan provides Building Positive Behaviours: A Supportive Approach Our specialist behaviour intervention support focuses on intensive strategies to address and reduce harmful or persistent behaviours. By developing a personalised behaviour support plan, we aim to prevent such behaviours from emerging or worsening. This plan includes positive support strategies tailored for you, your family, and support network, striving for the best outcomes in reducing or eliminating concerns, fostering a supportive and understanding environment for growth and positive change. Unlocking Positive Paths Unlocking Positive Paths: Enhancing Communication and Behaviour dives into understanding each individual’s unique needs through assessments, spotlighting the importance of tailored support for daily engagement and improved social interactions. Addressing behaviours of concern with a positive plan helps navigate or eliminate challenges, ensuring a foundation built on understanding and collaboration with families and carers. This approach not only enriches relationships but also fosters a nurturing environment for personal growth and safety, transforming challenges into opportunities for development and enriching lives. Behaviour management The NDIS Improved Relationships funding helps create a behaviour support plan and provides training for caregivers and families to address and reduce concerning behaviours linked to disabilities. This plan includes strategies to improve behaviour, enhance communication, and foster positive relationships, with training for those closely involved with the individual. It aims to identify what triggers challenging behaviours, offering solutions to manage or avoid these triggers, and works towards replacing difficult behaviours with positive ones, ensuring a supportive environment for everyone involved. Social Skills Development The NDIS Improved Relationships funding helps individuals enhance their social skills, focusing on better communication, active listening, empathy, conflict resolution, respect, and building relationships. It includes learning verbal and nonverbal cues, like body language and eye contact, and offers various learning formats such as individual, group, and online sessions. The support extends to participating in community, social, and recreational activities, alongside developing time management skills to boost independence and social engagement.
